supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: brow ridge extends laterally beyond the width of the eyes

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: muzzle region is lighter in pixel intensity compared to the darker periocular and cheek regions

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: small, distinct white circular mark on the right supraorbital ridge
other_distinctive_markers: large bright white or greyish patch on the superior cranial crown
